body: Got the M for weekend hikes and yard work, the ripstop cotton has taken some real abuse without tearing at the knee or pocket seams. Olive color is close to the listing, maybe a shade greener in direct sun. Six pockets are all genuinely usable, not decorative, which is rare these days.

Sized up to L from my usual M for extra room in the thigh and that was the right move, still true to size through the waist though. The cargo pockets sit a little lower than I expected so they catch on car seats sometimes, minor gripe. Fabric is breathable enough for warmer days.

The waist fit fine in a S but the inseam is long enough that I need to cuff them or get them hemmed, similar issue to other cargo styles I've bought. Olive color is accurate. The extra thigh pocket is handy for keeping my phone off my back pocket. Decent overall, just not a perfect out-of-box fit.
Sturdy, comfortable, olive is a nice muted tone.

I've gone through two other cargo pants from other brands and both wore thin at the knee within months, these are still solid after regular use for yard work and dog walks. Got the L, roomy through the leg but the waistband has a drawstring cinch so it doesn't feel sloppy. Ripstop weave feels genuinely heavier duty than most fast fashion cargos.

Went with XL and it fits comfortably loose without looking baggy, which is what I wanted for a relaxed style. One of the snap buttons on a side pocket felt a little loose out of the box, hasn't come off yet but I'm keeping an eye on it. Otherwise happy with the purchase.
True to size in M, comfortable for daily wear, would buy again.

Normally a S fits me fine in relaxed cargo styles but this one felt more like a fitted cut through the waist, could not sit comfortably for more than an hour. Fabric quality is fine, olive color matched the photos, but the actual cut was nothing like relaxed for me. Ended up returning for a refund since L was sold out.

Wasn't sure ripstop cotton would feel soft enough for everyday wear but it's actually broken in nicely after a few washes without losing shape. M was true to size for me, drawstring waist helps if you're between sizes. Only small thing is the color came out slightly darker than the online photo suggested, more of a deep olive than sage.

Movement is unrestricted even in a deep squat, which surprised me for cargo-style pants. Went with M and it sits true to size at the waist, maybe a touch snug if you're carrying stuff in the side pockets. Breathable fabric held up through a sweaty workout without clinging.

The olive shown online looked more khaki-green, what arrived is closer to a drab military tone which isn't really my style. Fit itself was okay in L, true to size, no complaints on cut or fabric weight. Just disappointed by the color mismatch since that was the main reason I picked this pair.

Ordered the M as a surprise for my son who lives in cargo pants for skating and hanging out with friends. He confirmed they fit true to size and said the fabric feels tougher than his other pairs, already scuffed one pocket on concrete with no visible damage. Easy wash care too which matters since he's not gentle with clothes.
Comfy for work shifts on my feet all day, olive looks good with basically any shirt I own. L is roomy but not falling off, cinches at the waist nicely. Will probably grab a second pair before summer.

Fabric is a heavier ripstop than I expected for the price, holds a crease along the front which I like. Ordered M, arrived true to size through the waist and thigh. Only knock is delivery took about four extra days past the estimate, package itself was undamaged when it showed up.

I compared the stitching on these to a pricier brand I already own and honestly the difference is minor, double stitching on the pocket flaps and a reinforced seat panel that most budget cargos skip. XL fits with room to layer a base layer underneath for colder days without feeling restrictive. Olive color held up fine through two washes, no fading around the pocket edges where I expected it most.
